findings.title: Default update-strategy tests skip enabling the now-mandatory rolling-updates feature
findings.body: The new operator documentation says the `rolling-updates` feature must be enabled or the Operator will fail, but `createInitialDeployment` returns before adding the feature to the Keycloak CR whenever `updateStrategy == null`. Both `testImageChange` and `testCacheMaxCount` are parameterized with `null` (the default `<not set>` strategy), so these cases either rely on the test image built by `Dockerfile-custom-image` already having the feature baked in, or they will fail if run against an image without it. The documented CR-based enabling path is therefore not exercised for the default strategy. Enable the feature in the CR for all test cases, or scope the documentation requirement to explicit update strategies.

findings.title: Recreate exit code changes from 4 to 3, breaking existing automation
findings.body: `RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE` changes from 4 to 3 while 4 is reused for the new `FEATURE_DISABLED` result. Any CI/CD pipeline that currently checks the actual runtime exit code 4 for a recreate-required result will now either see 3 or misinterpret 4 as “feature disabled”. The guide already documented 3, so this fixes a code/doc mismatch, but it is still an unannounced behavior change to the command’s scriptable contract. Prefer assigning a new code such as 5 to `FEATURE_DISABLED` to preserve the existing recreate value, or explicitly call out and version the breaking change.

findings.title: New and changed exit codes are not asserted
findings.body: The feature-disabled test only asserts the stderr message and never checks that the process exits with the documented code 4. Likewise `testWrongVersions` never asserts the recreate-required exit code after `RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE` changed to 3. Since the exit code is the primary scriptable API of this command, a regression in `picocli.exit` or `CompatibilityResult` would pass the test suite. Add assertions for `CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED` and `CompatibilityResult.RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE`, and cover the feature-disabled path for both `metadata` and `check`.
